text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Ligne Droite”—commonly known as Droite. 
It is a glamorous dance party that marks 
the end of the school year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With various feelings in their hearts, 
students look for a dance partner—a 
“date.” 
A friend, someone they admire, a rival... 
Spending a special time with them—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
But I want more! It's a grand banquet, 
after all! 
If you're gonna go wild with your crew, 
wouldn't you rather seize a massive 
treasure together!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What I want is, that's right, fame! 
That honorable title bestowed upon the 
pair who shines brighter than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! So you're aiming for “Best 
Date,” huh? 
Then you'll have to find someone super 
skilled. I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Who will intoxicate the audience gathered 
for the joy of dance? 
No need to even ask. Me. I alone shall 
create a paradise of intoxication!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And yet, oh, where are you? My accomplice 
who shall realize my ideals. 
Ah... Aaahh...! ...Ghaaa-hahahahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—! 
...Kgh, kukukuku... Hahahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"—Oh yeah! Found ya, partner! 
Give me your hand!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Oho...! Fascinating. 
You dare extend a hand toward me?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Whoaaa! Look at that! 
Kyaaa! What is that...?!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: What is—this commotion?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Eek! Um, uh, watch out over there! 
A pair of weirdos are dancing 
full-throttle down the hall—!"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"Ha ha ha ha haaa! 
Ah ha ha ha ha!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
""Running is permitted in the halls"— 
However—what is the meaning of this 
dance?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Whoops! If it isn't Kris S. 
Don't be such a stiff! I'm feeling on top 
of the world right now!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"We are demigods who have at last reunited 
with our other half. 
This impulse is something no mortal can 
restrain...!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Dance... Other half... Droite—are you 
referring to the Dater?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly! 
One look at her footwork was all the 
convincing I needed."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, our souls arrived at one and the 
same conclusion. 
'Together with her, victory shall be 
ours'...!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"—Wait, what...? Those two teamed up? 
—Whoa~, what an unexpected pair...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Kukuku... Well, well, isn't this ideal? 
It seems even the gossiping fae cannot 
hide their fascination. Let us proclaim 
it, Tap!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Hell yeah, listen up, folks! 
This year's Best Dater..."

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"Will be ours!" 
"Will be ours!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"—Whoaaaa! A declaration already, for 
real?! 
I can't even imagine what their dance will 
look like...!"

text_block_list.name: Mean-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"No way they're winning Best Dater. 
Just a couple of oddballs talking big..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, I can hear ya, missy. Oddballs are 
the best kind! 
Just look forward to a performance like 
you've never seen before!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Rejoice, for thou shalt bear witness to a 
miracle. 
We shall sear that very moment into thy 
innocent eyes."

text_block_list.name: Mean-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "We're fine, thanks. Let's go, everyone."

text_block_list.name: Followers
text_block_list.text: "Okaaay. *giggle*..."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Their cynical masks remain stubborn, it 
seems. No matter. 
More importantly... Tap."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, we start practice right after 
school! 
I'm itching to go!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"How passionate... 
An unexpected—pair—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"(Ligne Droite— 
Rudolf also approached me about 
participating.)"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"(School events are also a 'duty.' 
Enlivening the festivities will raise the 
students' morale.)"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"(All for the sake of the racing world. 
A Dater... I must choose one as well.)"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"K-Kris S-san...?!  
Are you feeling unwell?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry. 
Please—continue the lesson."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"(Dancing ability. The grit to keep up 
with my training. 
Sufficient... I believe. However...)"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not sure. —Is this... merely an easy 
whim? 
...Think—carefully. The decision—should be 
placed—on hold—..."
